## PROJECT PROPOSAL — WATCHTOWER

**What does your Skill do? (one sentence)**
Watchtower transforms unwatched CCTV footage into actionable security intelligence using natural language queries, cross-camera anomaly detection, and AI-generated HTML briefings with embedded video clips — all running locally on UGREEN AI NAS.

**Who is your target user, and what is their problem?**
Homeowners and SMBs with security cameras. 90% of CCTV footage is never reviewed until after an incident. Users have cameras but no time to review hours of footage, creating a false sense of security and missed evidence.

**What is your solution?**
Watchtower: an AI Skill for UGREEN NAS that lets users ask "What happened last night?" in plain English. It queries camera events, extracts relevant video clips, and generates an HTML security briefing with executive summary, timeline, playable clips, and recommendations — 100% local, zero cloud.

**What is the main user flow?**
1. User types natural language query (e.g., "show person detections last 24h")
2. Scanner Agent queries UGOS Surveillance → returns structured event list
3. Analyzer Agent extracts ±30s clips around each event via UGOS Video → saves to /Security/
4. Reporter Agent uses UGOS Knowledge (Nemotron) → generates HTML briefing with embedded clips, timeline, threat levels, recommendations
5. User reviews HTML report in any browser

**How is your idea different from existing tools?**
Unlike Hikvision/Dahua VMS (camera-locked, real-time only) or Ring/Nest (cloud subscription, dashboard-only), Watchtower is: (1) cross-vendor — reads any MP4/H.264 footage via filesystem; (2) natural language — no rule configuration; (3) AI-generated briefings — not just raw footage; (4) 100% local, zero subscription, zero cloud.

**Which UGREEN AI NAS features does your Skill use, and at which step?**
Files (read footage folder, save clips & HTML), Surveillance (query camera events), Video (extract ±30s clips), Knowledge (Nemotron AI reasoning for briefing). Chained: Surveillance → Video → Knowledge → Files.

**What is your technical approach?**
Python + uliya-skill-kit. 3 expert agents (Scanner, Analyzer, Reporter) orchestrated via Uliya standard. 3 CLI capabilities: query_events, extract_clips, generate_briefing. NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra via NIM (free tier) for reasoning. Free-tier only, Python stdlib, no external dependencies.

**What have you built so far? What is not built? What still needs testing on a NAS?**
Built: SKILL.md, CLI, 3 agents, NLP parser, confirmation gates, HTML template, error handling (24 codes), fallback chains. Not built: real UGOS API integration (mock for Round 1), face recognition module, scheduled briefings. Needs NAS testing: actual UGOS Surveillance/Video/Knowledge API calls on iDX6011 Pro.

**How will you test if you become a Finalist?**
Test cases: (1) Core: query "last 24h" → events → clips → HTML briefing. (2) Cross-vendor: Hikvision + Dahua footage in same folder. (3) Edge: empty results, codec failure, user declines confirmation, 100+ events memory test.

**Known limits, risks, dependencies:**
Limits: UGOS Surveillance API may differ from assumed interface; video extraction on ARM may be slow. Risks: hallucinated events, OOM on large folders. Dependencies: uliya-skill-kit (UGREEN), NVIDIA Nemotron (NIM free tier). All third-party components identified and disclosed.
